title: Golden bake alias promotion must match the golden variant (default vs hotplug)
answers: Manual golden bake with box_mem_boot_mib overwrote the default golden
Which snapshot alias does the pluggable-memory bake need to be promoted to?
Bake pluggable golden for task boxes
body: The golden bake workflow (.github/workflows/cd-tasks-golden-snapshot.yml) has a "Promote candidate to default" step that hardcodes `posthog-tasks-default`. A review comment flagged that a manual dispatch with `box_mem_boot_mib` set would therefore overwrite the fixed-size default golden with a pluggable one, while `HOGLAND_HOTPLUG_SNAPSHOT_ALIAS` (`alias:posthog-tasks-hotplug` in hogland_sandbox.py) is what flagged runs restore from. Any change to bake/promotion must keep the promoted alias in sync with the variant baked: pluggable (BOX_MEM_BOOT_MIB set) -> posthog-tasks-hotplug, fixed -> posthog-tasks-default. The scheduled run leaves both inputs blank and must keep baking the fixed 20 GiB default. The hotplug alias must exist before the flag is enabled for a team.
applies: cd-tasks-golden-snapshot workflow, bake-golden.sh, and hogland snapshot alias constants
